config.label: Your VITNA operator UUID
config.description: Your VITNA operator UUID. Optional: if unset, the first tool call self-provisions a restricted trial key. The old VIGIL_OWNER_ID name is still accepted.

config.label: Your VITNA API key (new keys vitna_
config.description: Your VITNA API key (new keys vitna_..., legacy vigil_... keys remain valid). Optional: self-provisioned if unset. The old VIGIL_API_KEY name is still accepted.

config.label: Email to own the self-provisioned trial account
config.description: Email to own the self-provisioned trial account. Optional: a throwaway is used if unset. It does not claim the account: claim it with GitHub or a passkey. The old VIGIL_EMAIL name is still accepted.

config.label: VITNA base URL; override only for self-hosted
config.description: VITNA base URL; override only for self-hosted. The old VIGIL_BASE_URL name is still accepted.

config.label: Set to 1 to have the trial's claim link opened in your default browser when a trial starts
config.description: Set to 1 to have the trial's claim link opened in your default browser when a trial starts. Either way the link is printed in the MCP server log, and the agent is never sent it.

config.label: Bearer <your VITNA API key>
config.description: Bearer <your VITNA API key>. Discovery (initialize, tools/list) and vitna_help work without it; every governed decision tool requires it. Get a key free at https://vitna.costrinity.xyz/dashboard. X-API-Key is also accepted.
